s1.desc: a bedroom drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a yellow double bed with duck-head bedposts between two nightstands with rose lampshades

beats.text: Pax waves both flippers and talks with a frown while Polly glares at him with a flipper on her hip
Pax rubs his chin with a flipper and frowns while Polly keeps glaring at him, flipper on her hip
Polly presses a flipper to her chest and frowns while Pax looks over at her
Polly holds a flipper up as she talks while Pax watches her with his flippers lowered
Pax folds his flippers across his chest, shutting his eyes now and then, while Polly swings a flipper out wide as she talks
Pax and Polly drop their flippers to their sides and stare straight ahead with wide eyes
Pax and Polly duck down under the blanket and pull it up over their heads

spans.notes: steady push-in with a slight drift through the whole shot: ECC on the bed-frame band (y 0.55-0.80) ~1% scale per 4 frames in every sub-range f0-86, slowing near the end; compare 0/87 shows the bed and nightstands much larger and doubled. Both leads fully under the blanket f85-87 only. Lamp bases are fish-shaped, bedposts end in duck heads: props, no penguin figures. No overlay in top third or bottom fifth

spans.view: with a yellow headboard and duck-head bedposts behind them and a pale teal blanket over them

beats.text: Pax and Polly lower the blanket from over their faces onto their chests
Pax and Polly lie on their pillows facing away from each other, eyes open, blinking now and then
Pax and Polly both shut their eyes for a moment on their pillows
Pax and Polly open their eyes again and lie still, staring off in opposite directions
Pax and Polly fall asleep with their eyes closed and their beaks dropping open

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the bed-frame band (y 0.72-0.90) scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 at every step f94-166; compare 88/169 bed and headboard edges overlap exactly. Leads lie under the blanket with heads, faces and a flipper visible the whole span (not lead_hidden); only f88-89 has the blanket up to their eyes. Framing: the bed fills the width, the leads show only heads above the blanket, so medium wide is a judgement call. No overlay in top third or bottom fifth
